payload.text: The carry-seam FX byte-identity is enforced by fx_carry_inputs_byte_identical: the FX arm of Carry (FxRates) lowers to VanillaInputs with forward/df_dom/df_for bit-identical (to_bits) to the native FX leaf, and the CostOfCarry arm is rejected (UnsupportedCarry). This is a pure byte-identity gate over the carry seam (ADR-0008). Supersedes a withdrawn spec:satisfies probe whose design-target sentinel did not resolve in this build.
